_policy: POST-CUTOVER BASELINE SEALING. Every successful cutover invalidates the tracked reference it
used, because R(L) == A can only hold while A describes current production.
A_next = R(L_post) is accepted for ONE reason: L_post matched the materialized target that
was just approved. Never because it is live, never because it is newer.
FAIL CLOSED: if the most recent record for a workflow is not SEALED, the next deployment of
that workflow is refused until it is.

sealProof.method: offline rebuild: applyDelta(delta(A,B), A), redacted, compared to R(L_current)

_note: SEALED 2026-08-27. Recorded UNSEALED first, because that was the truth: P7.5R deployed 45
nodes while the tracked reference was still the 33-node pre-Model-B export, so R(L) == A
could not hold and the next deployment failed closed rather than comparing against a
reference that described neither the old production nor the new one.
SEALING NEEDED A LIVE READ, but the acceptance test was offline-computable: R(L_pre) == A
held at the time, so the approved P7.5R target redacts to applyDelta(delta(A,B), A). The
fresh live read was required to equal that and did, with the version chain intact -- see
sealProof above and docs/P8_3A_P7_5R_BASELINE_SEAL.md. A proof, not a rubber stamp.
The 33-node pre-state is frozen at n8n/history/mppzthlkSJFr6Kle.pre-P7-5R-cutover.json;
its versionId must equal preVersionId here, and the tracked reference postVersionId.
SEALED 2026-08-28, immediately after the P8.3A cutover. A_next = R(L_post) is accepted for
ONE reason: L_post equalled the materialized target that was approved -- sealBaseline
recomputed that equality itself and would have refused otherwise.
The delta: +6 nodes, -1 (Read Settings, physically removed), 4 field changes, 9 rewires.
P8.3A-1 closed the hole that made this phase necessary twice over: Build Authority Unresolved
Event had no outgoing edge, so AUTHORITY_WRITE_NOT_PERSISTED was built per incident and
discarded; and APPROVED_EDGES was declared but never handed to the materializer, so at deploy
time it constrained nothing. Both halves are now enforced -- see the commit that precedes this
seal and qa/p83a-cutover-policy.test.mjs mutations 4c-4f.
The 45-node pre-P8.3A state is the reference this record supersedes; its versionId is
preVersionId here and the P7.5R record postVersionId.

sealProof.method: live: sealBaseline() redacted BOTH the approved target and the fresh post-deploy read, then required baselineEquivalence(R(C_live), R(L_post)).ok before returning A_next
sealProof._shaNote: the two shas differ by SHAPE, not content: approvedRedactedSha covers the four-field {name,nodes,connections,settings} projection of C_live, postLiveRedactedSha the whole redacted document. The equality that gates the seal is matches:true, computed on the safety-relevant surface by baselineEquivalence -- not string equality of these two.
